```artifact
Feature: System Access and Management

  Scenario: System availability based on PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode 1234
    Then the system should be available
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode 9999
    Then the system should be available
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode 1235
    Then the system should not be available

  Scenario: User login with valid credentials
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    And a user with username "user1" and password "pass123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "user1" and password "pass123"
    Then the login should be successful

  Scenario: User login with invalid credentials
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    And a user with username "user1" and password "pass123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "user1" and password "wrongpass"
    Then the login should fail with error message "Invalid credentials"

  Scenario: Secure credential storage
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    And a user with username "user1" and password "pass123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "user1" and password "pass123"
    Then the password should be securely stored

  Scenario: Doctor-Speciality mapping
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    And a doctor with ID "D1" is linked to Speciality "Cardiology"
    And a doctor with ID "D2" is linked to Speciality "Dermatology"
    When a user requests consultation for Speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the system should return doctor "D1"
    When a user requests consultation for Speciality "Dermatology"
    Then the system should return doctor "D2"

  Scenario: Doctor providing consultation to patients
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    And a doctor with ID "D1" is linked to Speciality "Cardiology"
    And a patient with ID "P1" requests consultation for Speciality "Cardiology"
    When the doctor "D1" provides consultation to patient "P1"
    Then the consultation should be recorded

  Scenario: Patient registration
    Given the system is configured with PinCodes [1234, 5678, 9999]
    When a new patient registers with name "John Doe" and age "30"
    Then a unique ID should be generated for the patient
```
